title: Create: Broken Bad usable stuff
description: This datapack brings a highly immersive, trippy, and intense visual/gameplay experience to Minecraft 1.21.1 Neoforge when consuming items from the Create: Broken Bad mod.
body:
## 🌟 Key Features

### 🌪️ The White Crystals Trip (40 Seconds)
* **Initial Burst:** You are engulfed in a thick cloud of white smoke and a loud elder guardian screech.

### 🌀 The Blue Crystals Trip (80 Seconds)
* **Initial Burst:** Massive ominous sound, ender dragon growl, and a violent burst of blue portal particles.

### 🧠 Hallucinations
While tripping, you will occasionally (randomly) experience.

### 🖥️ Trippy GUIs & Screen Glitches
Your screen interface and vision will periodically glitch out.

### 🍂 The Comedown
When the trip timer runs out, your screen clears, a low bell tolls, and you suffer a severe crash.
